title: feat(app-shell): the Studio option editor authors an option's lifecycle kind
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8DR4ycmjDiMqujsSBS8TVCg)_
Fixes #26729

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:Studio 字段检查器的选项编辑器,在单选 select / radio 字段的每个选项上新增「生命周期类别」选择(未设 / 进行中 / 成功结束 / 失败结束),写入 spec 已发布的 `kind`。
- 为什么改:对象把这个字段选为 Lifecycle 字段时,spec 要求每个选项都声明 `kind`,而 Studio 原来没有任何地方能写它,保存一律 422,只能走 API。
- 风险与回滚:只动 Studio 编辑器与 i18n 文案,不改 spec、不改引擎;多值字段不画控件也不写 `kind`,改成多值类型时会去掉 `kind`;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`ObjectFieldInspector.tsx` 的 `patchOptions` 与 `changeType`(写入与去除 `kind` 的两处),其次 `classifyOption`(非法 `kind` 走异常行)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/ObjectFieldInspector.optionKind-26729.test.tsx`,预期 16 个测试全过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **`kind` becomes an owned key of the picklist option editor.** `Option` gains `kind?: SelectOptionKind`; `classifyOption` moves it out of the `rest` bag into its own slot (the docblock's "the three parts move together": `Option`, `readOptions`, `patchOptions`). The vocabulary is read from the installed contract (`SelectOptionSchema.shape.kind.unwrap().options`), not re-listed.
- **A picker per option row** (`data-testid="option-kind"`, the shared Radix `Select`): "No kind" / Open / Won / Lost. "No kind" removes the key outright — absent stays absent, which is what lets `ObjectSchema` tell "declared open" from "forgot the key" under `stageField`.
- **Only where the spec accepts it.** The picker is drawn, and `patchOptions` writes `kind`, only on a single-value `select` / `radio` (`takesOptionKind`: `SINGLE_OPTION_TYPES` and `multiple !== true`, the same test `FieldSchema` applies). On a multi-value field no picker is drawn and no `kind` is written; a kind authored there by other means (which `FieldSchema` already refuses) is not written back. A retype to a type that cannot carry one drops the kinds, as a retype already drops a `picklist` the new type cannot name; a retype to `radio` keeps them.
- **An out-of-vocabulary `kind`** (`kind: 'closed'`) is a malformed row (`kind-not-valid`), carried verbatim like the other malformed shapes, rather than silently dropped.
- **The lifecycle hint.** When the object names this field as its `stageField` and an option still has no kind, the inspector shows one held-hint line saying so; it clears once every option has one.
- **i18n.** New `designer.field.*` rows in the `studio` namespace, `en` and `zh`: `optKind`, `optKind.unset` / `.open` / `.won` / `.lost`, `optMalformed.kindNotValid`, `hint.stageKinds`. No `engine.studio.settings.*` row. Patch changeset for `@object-ui/i18n` (app-shell is private).
- Not touched: `ObjectSettingsPanel.tsx` (the Lifecycle picker itself), the spec, the engine.

## Why

The Lifecycle field picker refused a Studio-authored select (`Option 'new' of field status declares no kind`), and the option editor had no `kind` control: the triage grade asks for the control for the published option `kind` (#23809).

## Tests

New `ObjectFieldInspector.optionKind-26729.test.tsx` (16 tests), every case ending at `ObjectSchema` / `FieldSchema` or the written document's keys:

- CONTROL: the Studio-built select is refused as the stage field at `fields.status.options.{0,1,2}.kind`.
- Picking Open / Won / Lost writes the three kinds, and `ObjectSchema` then accepts the object with `stageField: 'status'`; with one option left unset, the refusal names only that option.
- "No kind" removes the key; an existing kind round-trips through an edit of its own row and another row; the picker shows the stored kind.
- multiselect / checkboxes / `select` with `multiple: true`: no picker, no `kind` written, `FieldSchema` accepts.
- A kind authored on a multiselect is not written back; an out-of-vocabulary kind is a malformed row kept verbatim.
- A retype to Multi-Select drops the kinds; a retype to Radio keeps them; `FieldSchema` accepts both.
- The lifecycle hint appears while an option lacks a kind and clears once all have one; CONTROL: no hint when the object names another stage field.
- zh: the picker's name and the kind label come from the studio catalogue (`await loadStudioCatalogue('zh')` at import).

Ablation (one-shot, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, mutation committed-then-restored): deleting `if (o.kind && kindAllowed) out.kind = o.kind;` from `patchOptions` turned 5 of the 16 tests red (the three authoring cases, the round trip, the hint); restore verified blob == HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty.

## Acceptance notes

- `ObjectSettingsPanel`'s Lifecycle picker is unchanged; the order marked that line optional and the inspector's hint covers what the picker would have said.
- Two whole-tree scans in `ui/scripts/__tests__` (`check-i18n-dead-keys.test.ts` "on the real tree", `check-vi-mock-inherit.test.ts` "the sweep") each hit their 15 s test budget once on this shared box during the full `vitest run scripts/` (a different test each run); each file passes alone. Load-sensitive, not this diff; CI's run is the verdict.
